slides.title: A heavy Swedish name
slides.body:
In the 1700s, Swedish chemists called a very heavy mineral *tungsten*, heavy stone. English kept the name for the metal inside it.

The twist: in Swedish, that metal is called *volfram*.

caption:
Tungsten comes from Swedish: tung sten means heavy stone. It was the Swedish name for a very heavy mineral, and English kept it for the metal.

The twist: in Swedish the metal itself is called volfram, which is where its chemical symbol W comes from.

Which English word would you never have guessed was Swedish?
